A.summary: A is the prototype choice, with short via-free USB routes, a wide single-layer LED supply, and via drills clear of exposed SMD lands. Its flash clock return and RP2040 core-regulator bypass need improvement, and all three designs share a BOOTSEL contention risk.

B.summary: B has the smallest outline, strong ground stitching, and short local regulator bypasses. A 49.94 mm flash-select branch, remote input bulk capacitor, and unfilled via drills in the RP2040 and other solder lands reduce its order readiness.

C.summary: C has a 4.32 mm flash clock and a 0.50 mm LED supply, but cuts its only ground pour with signal routes and gives several fast signals poor return paths. Long regulator-capacitor returns, a recessed USB mating face, and in-pad drills add further risk.
